PhotoDNA_Api_Key_Description: Photo DNA Api Service Subscription Key (this app is only active with valid api key)
PhotoDNA_Quarantine_Target_Channel_Descr: Channel to move quarantined images to. Be sure to create this channel as documented.
PhotoDNA_Limit_Analysis_To_Channels_Csv_: Limit image analysis to specified channels
A comma separated values list of channels (e.g. "channelA,channelB") to limit image upload analysis to, all channels if empty
PhotoDNA_Watch_DMs_Description: Analyzes images in all rooms of type 'direct room', even if a watch list is set in 'Limit analysis to specfied channels'.
PhotoDNA_Enable_Automated_Report_Descrip: Automatically report matching images to NCMEC
PhotoDNA_NCMEC_OrgName_Description: The organization name to report violations under
PhotoDNA_NCMEC_ReporterName_Description: The reporter name to report violations under
PhotoDNA_NCMEC_ReporterEmail_Description: The email address to report violations under
PhotoDNA_NCMEC_TestMode_Description: Report violations to the NCMEC test end point
PhotoDNA_NCMEC_User_Description: The username used for the NCMEC cybertip API
PhotoDNA_NCMEC_Password_Description: The password used for the NCMEC cybertip API
PhotoDNA_Test_Connection_Command_Descrip: Verify the configured PhotoDNA API key and connectivity (admins only)
